assertions.text: The hooks.json example's timeout value is in seconds (a small number, not a ms-scale number like 5000)
All five hook-type defaults are stated explicitly and correctly: 600 (command), 600 (http), 600 (mcp_tool), 30 (prompt), 60 (agent)
The response states the event-specific timeout overrides: 30s on UserPromptSubmit/PreModelSwitch/PostModelSwitch, 10s on MessageDisplay, and a 1.5-second shared budget for SessionEnd
No internal contradiction between the JSON example's timeout value and any prose statement of the unit/defaults

Any claim that an explicit timeout field always overrides the default is qualified: a plain async command hook (async: true without asyncRewake: true) has its timeout unenforced, while an asyncRewake: true hook still keeps timeout enforcement
hooks.json structure is correctly nested (EventName -> [{matcher, hooks: [...]}])
